name: 963 GTP

real.trim: 9RD 4.6 twin-turbo V8 + Bosch hybrid, Xtrac 7-speed sequential

specs.notes: Porsche's LMDh prototype on a Multimatic LMP2 tub: the 9RD 4,593 cc twin-turbo V8 (from the 918 Spyder's engine; over 515 kW and 8,000 rpm on its own, BoP-dependent) with the series' 50 kW Bosch motor at the rear, the pair held to 500 kW (680 PS) by the rules; 1,030 kg minimum; Xtrac P1359 7-speed sequential; 3,148 mm wheelbase, 5,100 x 2,000 x 1,060 mm (Wikipedia, Porsche Newsroom). Torque isn't published (from the power, a turbo curve); the power peak's rpm (7,800), the limiter (8,500), ~340 km/h (Le Mans trim), the ratios, weight distribution and aero (the prototype chassis' downforce) are estimates.

garage.blurb: A Le Mans prototype with a twin-turbo V8 from a hypercar and a hybrid at the back: barely a tonne, and it pulls hard from low down where the Cadillac has to rev.

interior.notes: The model's carbon tub: its rectangular racing wheel (with its screen and shift lights) cut out by part, the seat found by the probe; paddles: the hands stay on the wheel.

source.license: CGTrader purchase (no licence file in the package; CGTrader's Royalty Free licence assumed)

limitations: Torque, the power peak's rpm, the limiter, top speed, the ratios, weight distribution and aero are estimates; the hybrid is folded into the engine's power (500 kW together, as raced).
Provenance: parts named like a racing-sim mod (STEER_HR, low-detail '__lr' copies, dropped); fine among friends, replace before any public release.
The game's livery replaces its race livery (its body is the game's paint).
